create_chat_completion: create a chat completion request to an oobabooga API endpoint using messages and model parameters
create_embeddings: create text embeddings from an input list via an oobabooga API endpoint
validate_environment: validate the oobabooga environment configuration with api_key, model, messages, and optional parameters
transform_request: transform litellm request parameters into an oobabooga-compatible chat completion payload
transform_response: transform an oobabooga API response into a litellm ModelResponse object
